raw_segments.text: Brutus, could you not have told him as you were lessened? When he had no power but was
a petty servant to the state, he was your enemy, ever spake against your liberties and
the charters that you bear I T.H. body of the wheel, and now arriving a place of potency
and sway O.T.H. state, if he should still malignantly remain fast foe to T.H. plebe,
your voices might be curses to yourselves. You should have said that as his worthy deeds
did claim no less than what he stood for, so his gracious nature would think upon you
for your voices and translate his malice towards you into love, standing your friendly lord.
